inv.desc_en:
COMPLETE BUSINESS FOR SALE (TRANSFER OF OWNERSHIP) - €1,470, 000 - MÁLAGA

PREMISES NOT INCLUDED; BUSINESS ONLY

Sale of an operational business engaged in the manufacturing and distribution of toy vending machines.

INCLUDES (FOR €1,470, 000):

"Telephone booth" style vending machines

"Yellow hen" vending machines (dispensing surprise-filled eggs)

Vending machines for colored capsules/balls

MASSIVE STOCK: Thousands of trays, display units, capsules, and toys (valued at hundreds of thousands of euros)

New, shrink-wrapped machines + spare parts

MACHINERY: Plastic injection molding equipment, industrial drills, FIAC industrial compressor, assembly table for coin mechanisms

Exclusive injection molds

Active client portfolio + full operational know-how

Reason for sale: Retirement.

Location: Málaga.

Unique opportunity; zero competition in manufacturing.

Serious inquiries only; proof of funds required.
